best_for: Listeners who stream on a computer most of the day and want the same library, playlists and podcasts they use on their phone.

points.title: Free means ads
points.text: The free tier is ad-supported, and Premium is sold on ad-free listening, unlimited skips and offline downloads, which tells you where the free tier stops.

points.title: Premium prices in the US
points.text: Individual is USD 12.99 per month, Student USD 6.99, Duo USD 18.99 for two people at one address, and Family USD 21.99 for up to six. New Premium users can get 3 months free, with that offer ending December 31, 2026. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Linux is a side project
points.text: Spotify says Linux is not a platform it actively supports; its engineers maintain the client in spare time. Spotify offers a Snap and its own Debian repo. The Flatpak listed here is a community build that Flathub does not mark as verified, x64 only.

points.title: Linux lags behind
points.text: The Linux build here is 1.2.95 while Windows and Mac are on 1.3.10, so new features may reach Linux late or not at all.

points.title: Platform details
points.text: Windows installs per user on x64 and Arm64, with no admin rights needed. The Mac apps for Intel and Apple silicon need macOS 13 or later.

points.title: No old versions
points.text: Every platform lists only the current release. If an update breaks something, you cannot roll back from this site.
